disposition_reason: Annex 1 cadmium table sets 0.8 mg/kg for chocolate containing or declaring >=50 to <70% total cocoa solids and 0.9 mg/kg for >=70%, dry matter basis, as prepared for wholesale or retail distribution. Clause 4(2) makes Codex CXS 193 MLs apply to foods not listed in Annex 1.
disposition_locator: Annex 1, 1. Cadmium (cont.), 'Chocolate Products' rows, PDF p. 4; Clauses 4 and 7

study.basis: whole commodity as prepared for wholesale or retail distribution; class by % total cocoa solids on a dry matter basis

regulatory.instrument: Notification of the Ministry of Public Health (No. 414) B.E. 2563 (2020) Re: Standards for Contaminants in Food (unofficial English translation)
regulatory.product: Chocolate Products: Chocolate containing or declaring ≥ 50% to < 70% total cocoa solids on a dry matter basis (including sweet chocolate, Gianduja chocolate, semi-bitter table chocolate, Vermicelli chocolate/chocolate flakes, and bitter table chocolate)
regulatory.status: in force 180 days after publication in the Government Gazette of 20 May 2020 (Clause 7; computed ≈ 16 November 2020)
